# MartiX.AlphaRehearsal

This immutable fixture represents the oldest retained Experimental Public Alpha
Generated Solution used by the Platform Migration rehearsal.

- Platform Version: `0.1.0-preview.1`
- Platform Contract Version: `0.1.0-preview.1`
- Maturity: Experimental Public Alpha
- Production support: none
- Rehearsal target: `1.0.0-beta.1`

The rehearsal changes the application owner from `MartiX.AlphaRehearsal` to
`MartiX.BetaRehearsal`, upgrades the exact first-party package version, and
records a `rehearsed` migration ledger entry. This evidence does not make the
alpha fixture retroactively supported.
